usage: The word 合約 (hap6 joek3) refers to a contract or agreement, commonly used in legal and business contexts.
合約 (hap6 joek3) is a noun, and it can be the subject or object in a sentence.
You can specify the type of contract by adding a word before 合約, like 租約 (rental contract) or 勞動合約 (labor contract).
It is often used with verbs such as 簽 (sign), 續 (renew), or 違反 (breach).
合約 (hap6 joek3) can also appear in questions when discussing terms and conditions.
